codeReview.summary: Fail. The commit does reconcile the frozen scope to 13/13 resolved in the current repo state and it now surfaces corrupt delivery-audit artifacts explicitly in both the CLI and web UI. However, the closeout trail is not durably anchored to the actual mission closeout artifact: the closeout payload simply reuses whatever status update is currently the latest published project update, so any later non-closeout publish will silently relabel the mission closeout evidence across both surfaces.

issues.description: `loadLinearProjectCloseoutAudit()` is fed `latestPublishedPath/title/At` from `audit.statusUpdates.latestPublished`, which is just the most recent published project update rather than a closeout-specific artifact. That means a later unrelated status-update publish will make the closeout section point at the wrong evidence file/title, so the feature does not reliably preserve an auditable mission closeout trail even though `.hack/linear/projects/7a3c8adf-ede5-4d3a-8779-9c32695c76bf/status-updates/published/2026-03-25-mission-closeout-audit.md` exists today.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared worker procedure does not carry forward the mission rule that user-facing web changes must be validated with `agent-browser`, so this feature was marked as having followed procedure even though the web proof was only a routed-page curl/text scrape.
